name: Food Truck Chef - Full Course Edition
description:
About This Game

Love food truck cooking games? Get ready to unleash your inner chef with Food Truck Chef! Join Emily on a global culinary journey, preparing mouthwatering recipes from tacos and sushi to pizza and beyond!

Food Truck Chef is an exciting, fast-paced cooking and management game where your culinary dreams come to life on wheels! Start with a humble food truck where you'll prepare meals, satisfy customers, and work your way up to transform it into the ultimate foodie hotspot!

Become a Master Chef on wheels

Experience the thrill of running your own food truck empire and strive to become a top chef! Race against the clock, juggle multiple orders, and keep everything running smoothly. Make your customers happy with perfectly cooked delicious meals, stay organized under pressure, and watch your success grow with new challenges and destinations! 

Bling your Truck with upgrades

Build your food truck and make it the coolest mobile restaurant on the block! Unlock a variety of unique and eye-catching decorations to attract more customers. Upgrade kitchen appliances that will boost your cooking speed and help you prepare even more orders. 

Cook and Travel

Discover exciting locations and unlock new levels, each with a whole new set of special dishes to master. With more than 800 tasty recipes from around the globe, 700+ fun levels, and over 19 vibrant locations, you’re in for a flavorful adventure! From the bustling Oriental Street and the smoky flavors of BBQ Street to the sweet delights of Donut and Waffle Street, take on every challenge and conquer each culinary mission in this addictive time management game! 

Key features

  • Endless fun: Discover hundreds of levels, dishes, and upgrades to keep you entertained.

  • Addictive gameplay: Easy to learn, hard to master, with fast-paced cooking game mechanics.

  • Colorful visuals: Enjoy lively, engaging art that brings each food truck scene to life.
short_desc: Manage and build your Food Truck! Cook global dishes, upgrade your kitchen, and serve hungry customers in this fast-paced cooking game. Travel the world, play fun cooking challenges, and become the ultimate culinary master!
